# LEL Convert

> Convert %LEL readings to ppm and percent by volume for common gases, see where 10% LEL falls, and train on air monitoring and gas detection.

LEL Convert (https://lel-converter.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Air Monitoring & Gas Detection, 40-Hour HAZWOPER training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://lel-converter.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

Monitoring in the context of site safety. Enroll: https://lel-converter.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
